title: Hruday boundary comparison of the Heisenberg dynamics of the named constructions on compact windows
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0), 21 omitted faces per anchor entering as -(tau/3)W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; both signs |tau|<=10^-8, the -tau value a replay of the same |tau| formula; cover R={0,e_z} of the original xz Wilson loop, 48 links, 36 endpoints; observables A in B(H_R); common clock theta=alpha t/hbar with the window |theta|<=8, i.e. U=1 in the internal normalized time u=theta/8), with the two named construction families F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N at least 2, with the Lieb-Robinson bound of Nachtergaele-Sims arXiv:1410.8174v1 Theorem 3.1, eqs. (51)-(52), quoted from the committed excerpt (PDF sha256 501af040512f2bdb62344ecbd093664e79ad1861338eabbce2c9791fca4e2fba), the unbounded on-site Casimirs h_b in the on-site slot of (44) and handled by the interaction picture, and the AQ1 constants F(r)=(1+r)^-4 on the coarse l1 metric, C<=224, ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau| for the whole-star interaction Phi (J=28|tau|, four incident stars) and ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau| for the owner-set interaction Phi' (49 faces per site), substituted as upper bounds by monotonicity: (1) H^{F2,pad}_N minus H^{F1}_N is the sum of the 28N(5N+1) extra faces (enumerated on Lambda_2 to Lambda_5; per anchor 17, 13 and 5 faces when exactly one coordinate equals N, 10, 3 and 1 when two do, none at the corner), each charged once with norm |tau|/3, every owner on the outer layer at coarse l1 distance at least N-1 from e_z and at least N from 0 (both attained), plus the padding on-site terms, which factor out of the evolution exactly and are never charged. (2) Define b(N) = K_cmp (5N+1) N^-3 with K_cmp = 3969/155720800000000 (about 2.54879e-11; forward route: Duhamel with the inner F1 evolution, whole-star Phi, tier polynomial_lieb_robinson, route duhamel_inner_f1; margin about 2.354 against the frozen 6x10^-11). For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8 and every A in B(H_R) with ||A||<=1 on the fixed cover R, the finite-box Heisenberg evolutions T^{F1,N}_theta and T^{F2,N}_theta of the named construction families F1 and F2 on the same centered coarse cube Lambda_N satisfy ||T^{F2,N}_theta(A)-T^{F1,N}_theta(A)|| <= b(N) for |theta|<=8 in the common clock theta=alpha t/hbar; this is an algebraic comparison of the dynamics of the named constructions on a compact time window at a rate in N, not equality of GNS dynamics or of correlation functions of different states, not a uniform-in-time statement, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a. The reverse route (Duhamel with the inner F2 evolution, owner-set Phi', route duhamel_inner_f2) proves the same inequality with the smaller labelled second-route constant K'_cmp = 452554889222515527/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 1.48469e-11, margin about 4.041); both constants are quadratic in tau (the first order vanishes because no extra face meets R), with exact tau/100 ratios 1953058850/194651 and 38176688920663121234473000000/3810205403940325763421973 inside the preregistered bracket [9500,10500]. (3) For F = F1 and F = F2, sup over M greater than N of ||T^{F,M}_theta(A)-T^{F,N}_theta(A)|| <= K_F/(N-1) ||A|| for |theta|<=8 and N at least 2, at the polynomial rate in N at fixed spacing: F1 with K_F1 = 9261/155720800000000 (about 5.94718e-11, forward, faces charged once, inner F1) and the second route 12128856933354903/118967041015625000000000000 (about 1.01951e-10, reverse, whole stars, inner F1 on Lambda_M); F2 with K_F2 = 117747/1245766400000000 (about 9.45177e-11, forward, one F1-inner Duhamel plus the comparison) and the second route 1055961408185869563/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 3.46428e-11, reverse, owner-set Phi', faces charged once); every value is at most the frozen 2.5x10^-10 (margins about 4.204, 2.452, 2.645 and 7.217); a bound for N to N+1 alone is not used as a Cauchy estimate. (4) Hence the F1 and F2 finite-box evolutions of every A in B(H_R) converge as whole sequences in norm, uniformly for |theta|<=8, and the F2 limit dynamics equals the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta: ||T^{F2,N}_theta(A)-T_theta(A)|| <= min(K_F1, second-route K_F2)/(N-1) ||A||, and on every local algebra the same Duhamel sum with R replaced by a finite region tends to zero on every compact window, so the two automorphism groups agree on the quasi-local algebra. (5) AQ1 sections 4-5 are rerun for every subsequential F2 limit state with F2's own diagonal extraction (AY1): stationarity under T_theta, strong continuity of the GNS evolution and a nonnegative generator, with the physical cyclic space reducing it. Not admitted: equality of GNS dynamics or of correlation functions of different states, a common limit state or convergence of states, uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state, translation invariance, any uniform-in-time statement, exponential decay in N with the polynomial Lieb-Robinson function, any rate or estimate in the lattice spacing a, a continuum or weak-coupling statement, and scientific priority.
limitations: Only the zero-selected patterned family (selected triple (0,0,0)), the cover R={0,e_z}, fixed spacing and |tau|<=10^-8, with the two named families F1 and F2 on centered cubes Lambda_N, N at least 2; nothing transfers to literal vertex boxes, periodic or orthant boxes, nonzero selected triples, the uniform route-B model, weak coupling or the continuum

Algebraic Heisenberg dynamics of the named constructions on a compact window only: no equality of GNS dynamics, no equality of correlation functions of different states, no common limit state and no convergence of states is established (F1 and F2 limit states remain subsequential and are not identified with each other); those need a proved common state (BB2)

The frozen constants hold for |theta|<=8 (U=1); the bounds grow like U^2/(1-vU/3) and nothing is claimed uniformly in time; outside the window only qualitative convergence on compact windows is used (for the O6 rerun)

Every rate is a rate in N at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (a coarse step is (4a,2a,a)): order N^-2 for the comparison and 1/N for the Cauchy estimates with the polynomial F(r)=(1+r)^-4; no exponential decay in N is claimed, the optional exponential instance was not executed, and no estimate is uniform in the lattice spacing a

All constants are upper bounds: the admitted ||Phi||_F<=2268|tau| is four times the exact (48) supremum 567|tau| and ||Phi'||_F<=1323|tau| is 12.25 times 108|tau| (recorded, not used); the all-size face sum 168(5N+1)N^-3 is 20 to 31 times the enumerated sum at N=2 to 5

Inherited without re-proof: Nachtergaele-Sims Theorems 3.1 and 4.1 as transcribed in the committed excerpt (not machine-checked); AQ1's C<=224 and ||Phi||_F bounds (arithmetic re-verified); AM2's simple ground state and gap for F2 boxes and F2 compactness and diagonal extraction via AY1; the I1 dictionary; Stone's theorem, Fourier inversion and the tensor-product exponential of commuting self-adjoint operators on separate factors

Independence is limited: the contract, the selection note and the AY2 obligations table name the route and the constants; the routes differ in the inner family, the interaction indexing, the constants, the exponential remainder bound, the enumeration and the code; all agents are correlated model agents; both producers wrote their final files after the skeptic pre-comparison commit, so isolation is shown by disclosure and content, not by commit order

The producer checkers do not pin every labelled value: five silent source edits (labelled refinements, a retained weaker bound, preview strings) pass the producer checkers and are caught only by the skeptic value validator; the gate binds the exact rationals above
The -tau evaluations replay the same |tau| formula and are not a second confirmation
Scientific priority is unverified; the Lieb-Robinson and limit-dynamics theorems are credited to Nachtergaele-Sims and the O6 strategy to AQ1 (Gauvin arXiv:2503.15539v3 Supplement A.10)
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AQ_patterned_zero_selected) at both signs |tau|<=10^-8; construction families F1 (AQ1 centered whole-star boxes) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding) on the same Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N at least 2; finite-box Heisenberg evolutions T^{F,N}_theta of A in B(H_R), cover R={0,e_z}, window |theta| at most 8 in theta=alpha t/hbar; l1 metric on the coarse factor lattice; Lieb-Robinson function F(r)=(1+r)^-4 with the AQ1 constants
decision: Admit the algebraic comparison of the Heisenberg dynamics of the named constructions on the compact window |theta| at most 8: ||T^{F2,N}_theta(A)-T^{F1,N}_theta(A)|| <= K_cmp (5N+1) N^-3 ||A|| with the forward headline K_cmp = 3969/155720800000000 (about 2.5488e-11; inner F1 evolution, whole-star constants, polynomial_lieb_robinson tier, route duhamel_inner_f1) and the reverse second route 452554889222515527/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 1.4847e-11; inner F2 evolution, owner-set constants, route duhamel_inner_f2), both below the frozen 6x10^-11; within-family Cauchy estimates over all M greater than N at the honest O(1/N) rate in N: F1 9261/155720800000000 (about 5.947e-11, forward, face by face) and 12128856933354903/118967041015625000000000000 (about 1.0195e-10, reverse, whole-star), F2 117747/1245766400000000 (about 9.452e-11, forward, through F1) and 1055961408185869563/30481402343750000000000000000 (about 3.464e-11, reverse, own family), all below the frozen 2.5x10^-10; the F2 evolutions converge as a whole sequence on the window and their limit is the AQ1 limit dynamics T_theta; AQ1 sections 4-5 rerun for every subsequential F2 limit state (AY2 row O6 closed within scope); the extra-face source 28N(5N+1) enumerated and proved for all sizes, charged once, at l1 distance at least N-1 from R; the F2 padding on-site terms factor out of the evolution exactly; the Lieb-Robinson inequality and the limit-dynamics theorem quoted verbatim from the committed Nachtergaele-Sims excerpt (Theorem 3.1 eqs. (51)-(52), Theorem 4.1 eq. (77)); every constant quadratic in tau with tau -> tau/100 ratios 10019.6 to 10033.6 inside the preregistered bracket [9500,10500]. The first order vanishes exactly because no extra face meets R and the zero-coupling dynamics keeps B(H_R) invariant. Recorded non-blocking: the stale control bracket [9900,10100] in new_control_semantics (the preregistered [9500,10500] governs; no producer ratio was rejected); four controls without frozen semantics (implemented from their earlier-round meaning); the observable id names N to N+1 while the target is the sup over M greater than N (the sup is proved); notation b(N)/B(N) and tau/T; no N_0 or clock field in parameters; the route labels live only in plan.json; the Nachtergaele-Sims section title is cited, not used as project wording; the exact supremum of ||Phi||_F is 567|tau| (108|tau| for Phi'), recorded and not used; the forward F2 constant is built through F1 and is 2.73 times the reverse's own-family value; the reverse K_cmp is its own directed formula, between the skeptic's sharp enclosure and closed form; commit order skeptic 7daf273 before reverse 9f207fe and forward 302347b, isolation resting on disclosure and content. This is algebraic dynamics of the named constructions on a compact window at a rate in N: no equality of GNS dynamics or of correlation functions of different states, no uniform-in-time statement, no uniqueness of any ground state, nothing uniform in the lattice spacing a.
